learning_outcomes.text: Explain the structure of an automation solution with PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) and plan a simple system based on a needs and cost analysis.
Identify properties and limits of modern networked automation solutions.
Apply selected methods of control engineering for own projects in the form of structured software development (PLC).

syllabus_topics: Technology for data coupling between real and virtual world (sensor and actuator circuits)
Structure and design of PLCs and their networking (via bus and wireless systems)
Structured programming of PLCs (using the IEC-61131 ST/FUP language) considering the special real-time properties of PLCs
Use of mobile test cases with built-in PLC (or microcontroller boards), which are to be configured and programmed by the students according to instructions.

assessment_methods.method: Presentation of project work (configuration and programming of a PLC)

assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the project work. The grade is weighted according to credit points.
